site.title: JAGAVE — Pre-launch ritual for inner radiance

hero.subheadline: A small-batch coffee ritual pressed against a quiet library of functional compounds — marine collagen, ceremonial matcha, lion's mane, and L-theanine. Less jitter. More glow. Twenty-four grams of intention, every cup.
hero.imageAlt: A slow morning coffee ritual in soft ivory ceramic

manifesto.label: Our Intention
manifesto.title: A cup of coffee should give more than it takes.
manifesto.text: We believe a cup of coffee should give more than it takes. That mornings deserve a slower ritual. That clarity should not cost you calm. So we pressed twenty grams of single-origin beans against a quiet library of functional compounds — L-theanine for focus, collagen for skin, lion's mane for nerve, ceremonial matcha for grace. The result is not a beverage. It is a daily practice, pressed slowly into twenty-four grams.
manifesto.signature: "Radiance is not a finish. It is a frequency."

principles.title:
Three rules, pressed
into every batch.
principles.description: We treat coffee like skincare — a daily ritual where origin, compound, and patience each carry equal weight. There are no shortcuts. No fillers. No marketing dust. Just three rules we refuse to break.

items.title:
Single Origin,
Traceable to the Farm.
items.body: We source from one farm per batch — currently Kyoto Prefecture's Uji highlands, 1,200m elevation, harvested November 2024. Every batch carries the lot number, the farmer's name, and the altitude. If we can't tell you who grew it, we won't make it.

items.title:
Functional Compounds,
Clinically Dosed.
items.body: Every compound is dosed at clinically-studied levels — not pinch-dusted for label appeal. 200mg L-theanine. 5g hydrolyzed marine collagen. 500mg dual-extracted lion's mane. 2g ceremonial-grade matcha. No proprietary blends. No hidden percentages.

items.title:
Cold Brewed Slowly,
Over Eighteen Hours.
items.body: We steep the grounds for eighteen hours at 4°C, then reduce the extract at low pressure to preserve the L-theanine and collagen. The result is a concentrate with 67% less acidity than hot-brewed coffee, naturally sweeter, with the functional compounds fully intact.

formula.title:
The seven compounds
behind your radiance.
formula.description: Each ingredient earns its place through three filters: clinically studied, traceable to source, and perceptible in the cup. Scroll sideways to walk the shelf.

ingredients.name: Single-Origin Bean
ingredients.description: Washed and sun-dried over 14 days at 1,200m elevation. Notes of white tea, citrus peel, and a long mineral finish. The structural base that gives the ritual its gentle caffeine curve.

ingredients.name: Ceremonial Matcha
ingredients.description: First-flush leaves from a 200-year-old Uji tea garden, stone-ground to 5 microns. Adds a slow-release caffeine tail and vegetal sweetness that rounds the coffee's bitterness.
ingredients.imageAlt: Ceremonial matcha powder in a stone bowl

ingredients.name: L-Theanine
ingredients.description: A pure amino acid from green tea, fermented enzymatically rather than synthesized. Smooths the caffeine spike into a four-hour plateau — focus without the jitter, calm without the drowsiness.

ingredients.name: Marine Collagen
ingredients.description: Wild-caught North Atlantic cod, hydrolyzed to a 1,000-dalton peptide for 95% absorption. Type I collagen — the kind your skin actually uses. Dissolves clear, tastes of nothing.

ingredients.name: Lion's Mane
ingredients.description: Fruiting bodies only — no mycelium, no fillers. Dual-extracted in water and alcohol to capture the compounds studied for nerve growth factor stimulation.

ingredients.name: Camu Camu
ingredients.description: A small Amazonian berry, freeze-dried within 48 hours of harvest to preserve the anthocyanins that pair with collagen for skin synthesis and a bright, clean finish.

ingredients.name: Volcanic Mineral Water
ingredients.description: Drawn from a 90m well in Kagoshima, filtered naturally through Shirasu volcanic tuff. A soft mineral profile that pulls cleanly without bitterness.

ritualMeta.title:
Four minutes, four steps,
every morning.
ritualMeta.description: The Jagave ritual is engineered for slowness. Four minutes from kettle to cup — enough time to set an intention, not so long that you skip it. Here's how we make it.

ritual.title: Heat water to 92°.
ritual.description: Bring filtered water to a rolling boil, then rest for ninety seconds until it lands at 92°C. Too hot and you'll burn the matcha. Too cool and the collagen won't dissolve. A kitchen thermometer is worth the ten dollars.

ritual.title: Measure 24 grams of Jagave.
ritual.description: Two level scoops. The dose is calibrated for a 220ml cup. Don't eyeball it. The functional compounds are dosed to the gram, and so is the caffeine.

ritual.title: Whisk in slow circles.
ritual.description: Pour the water in two stages — first 60ml to bloom, whisk in slow figure-eights for fifteen seconds, then the remaining 160ml in a steady stream. A bamboo chasen is traditional; a milk frother works fine.

ritual.title: Wait four minutes. Then drink.
ritual.description: Let the cup rest. Use the time. Look out a window. Set an intention. Then drink slowly, over the next twenty minutes.
